positive_snippets:
The Orion Express staff is very helpful & they catered to all my needs very carefully. The staff was extremely polite.

The House Keeping staff was prompt in service. They daily cleaned my room.

I am 101% satisfied with the hotel. It is not expensive at all given the fact that it is located in Delhi's posh Kailash colony.

Kailash colony I can say is Delhi's central place & all monuments in Delhi are nearby or well connected with Kailash colony metro.

The added advantage of the hotel is that it is located right next to the Kailash colony metro & also has a pharmacy & a good & not expensive hospital next to it.

I have plans to come to Delhi again & I will stay in this hotel only.

We stayed at this hotel from 29th January to 5th February for our training, and the overall experience was excellent.
The hotel staff was very polite, supportive, and always ready to help.
Special appreciation to Mr. Harvinder Singh and Harsh for their outstanding service and warm behavior.

Had a wonderful stay on 26th October, the location and overall ambience is top notch, it is adjacent to Kailash Colony metro station for which I will rate it 5 stars and the staff is very helpful and active in helping guests.
The food quality was above average but presentation and taste was good.
The rooms are spacious and amenities are splendid. There was no construction work in the building as some reviews mentioned which made hesitant, glad I choose this place to stay. Hope they improve their lobby and smoking area. Lift is of old style double door type which was ok for me.
A good family friendly place to stay under budget value for money and comfortable.
negative_snippets:
There is no maintenance. For 13K this is a scam. The property was very dirty, seemed shady and the taps in the shower not working! The furniture in the room was dusty.
No iron or room fridge.
The lift was very small and the whole experience is bad. Overall the propery is in the 1-2k segment.
Why Google or Booking.com gave a good review, I can't understand.
The legend inn above 3rd wave cafe seemed a better place.
